description:
Vertical media across post feeds

- The Vertical button now uses the current native post feed, including Home, subreddit, profile Posts, Popular and saved feeds.
- Images, galleries and videos follow that feed's order and pagination. Each viewer owns its source pager and snapshot; old post IDs are skipped.
- Tap to reveal titles, usernames and the native tappable subreddit overlay.
- The underlying feed follows the selected media post using Reddit's scroll-to-ID event. Reopening preserves that position, including profile sticky headers and changing feed indexes.
- Cache viewport updates happen while the viewer is open; closing it releases the snapshot and cancels queued pagination.

Compatibility: Reddit 2026.14.0. The patch retains its existing name, "Reddit - Vertical home feed", so existing Morphe selections continue to work.

Verification: all 21 patches applied with the 18 upstream defaults from Morphe v1.46.0; 14 vertical and 10 NSFW regression checks passed. Authenticated emulator checks cover Home, subreddit, profile Posts and Popular, vertical swiping, hidden initial controls, community navigation, paging, Back and reopening. Final cache-viewport integration was rechecked on Home and profile. No recorded crashes or scroll-sync errors.
